title: Wood Frogs Survive With 65% Of Their Body Water Frozen
hook: Wood frogs survive with 65% of their body water frozen.
closing: Understanding this survival trick could reshape how we protect living tissue from cold.
question: Would you believe this frog survived?

segments.say: A wood frog survives with 65% of its body water frozen, far beyond most vertebrates' lethal threshold.
A wood frog survives 16 degrees below freezing, extending life into temperatures ordinary frogs cannot tolerate.
Wood frogs reach 68 degrees latitude, letting them inhabit winters that exclude most frog species.
